_about: Activity coefficient at infinite dilution of ethyl acetate (2) in water (1), 273 K to 313 K, from Fenclova et al. (2014). Rows as in the ThermoML Archive record: T in K, gamma_2 at x_2 = 0.

source.citation: D. Fenclova, A. Blahut, P. Vrbka, V. Dohnal, Temperature dependence of limiting activity coefficients, Henry's law constants, and related infinite dilution properties of C4-C6 isomeric n-alkyl ethanoates/ethyl n-alkanoates in water, Fluid Phase Equilibria 375 (2014) 347-359
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, data set of compounds 1 water + 2 ethyl acetate, property activity coefficient of compound 2, constraint mole fraction of compound 2 = 0. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Pressure constraint 101 kPa in the record. Expanded uncertainties (95 %) in the record: 3, 3.8, 4.4, 4.7, 4.7, 5, 5.5 (about 7 %). Read twice from the ThermoML Archive (XML and JSON files); the reads disagreed on the first temperature (273.35 vs 273.15 K); a third and fourth read quoting the raw XML and JSON both give 273.35.
